scientific_integrity: The analytic proof establishes the all-integer-exponent norm and sharp finite-order barrier. Computations stress-test exact identities but are not used as infinite proofs. Literature priority is provisional; independent review is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only three consecutive characters and integer even exponents at least four.
When the character order is between three and twice the moment index, only strict excess over the nonaliased constant is established, not its exact sharp value.
Historical research may contain an equivalent all-exponent formula under different notation.
title: All-even sharp norms for three consecutive characters and the exact finite-order aliasing barrier
